fact: Kenya's Civil Registration Services say interoperability between CRVS and National ID systems is established: parents' national ID details are in birth records and the Birth Entry Number is in National ID registration, with birth records used to verify identity at ID registration.

Authorities say birth registration is being digitised and linked to the national ID system through Maisha Namba, and the Interior Secretary says the data for automatic ID issuance at 18 will come from the civil registry.

Immigration PS Belio Kipsang said on 6 October 2026 the Interior Ministry was finalising talks with the Ministry of Health to integrate the civil registration system with hospital management systems, and that the UPI system is being integrated with education and civil registration records.

PS Belio Kipsang told the National Assembly committee that development of a hospital e-notification system is complete and will be rolled out soon, relaying each birth to Civil Registration Services, which will issue the child a Unique Personal Identifier (Maisha Number) that becomes the national ID number at 18.
